quick_facts.label: What the job is
quick_facts.value: Industrial production managers plan, direct or coordinate the work and resources needed to manufacture products within cost, quality and quantity specifications.

quick_facts.label: Other names for it
quick_facts.value: Job titles O*NET reports for this occupation (Industrial Production Managers) include Manufacturing Manager, Plant Manager, General Production Manager and Production Control Manager.

sections.heading: What a production manager does
paragraphs: Industrial production managers plan, direct or coordinate the work and resources needed to manufacture products within cost, quality and quantity specifications.

The tasks below are taken from the O*NET profile for Industrial Production Managers. O*NET is the US Department of Labor's occupation database, so this describes the job as it is profiled in the United States; titles and duties in Indian companies can differ.
bullets: Set and monitor product standards, directing testing during processing.
Review production schedules and orders to make decisions about inventory requirements.
Work with technical and administrative staff to resolve production problems.
Develop production tracking and quality control systems.

sections.heading: How people get into this job
paragraphs: O*NET profiles this job under Industrial Production Managers. The routes below are the ones the Career Tree map links to it.
O*NET is the US Department of Labor's occupation database, so this describes the job as it is profiled in the United States; titles and duties in Indian companies can differ.
bullets: Common routes into this job on the Career Tree map: Production Engineer; Manufacturing Engineer.
Less common routes on the map: MBA (Master of Business Administration); Industrial Engineer; Health and Safety Engineer.
